cause: The utility armed ps5000aRunBlock before calling ps5000aSetSigGenBuiltInV2. The PicoScope driver does not permit the signal-generator configuration while the device is busy with a block acquisition.
evidence: The status record contains no pico_generator_applied field because the SDK call raised before returning success.
HF2LI settings were restored and both T660 units matched safe idle.
prospective_correction: Keep the confirmed electrical settings unchanged; configure the generator before ps5000aRunBlock, then immediately acquire the channel-A-triggered block and force zero afterward.
